# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description }}

{{ site.title }} by {{ site.author.name }} is a blog about Ruby on Rails development tips, tutorials, and best practices. Topics include Hotwire (Turbo, Stimulus), ViewComponent, ActiveRecord, authentication, authorization, deployment, and general web development with Rails.

The blog is published at {{ site.url }} and is licensed under GNU AGPL v3.

## How to read this blog efficiently

**Append `.md` to any post URL to get its raw Markdown source.** This is the preferred way to read a post: it is the text the author wrote, with code fences and headings intact, at roughly a third of the tokens of the HTML page. Do not scrape the HTML.

    {{ site.url }}/wicked-pdf-to-sghtmltopdf     <- HTML page
    {{ site.url }}/wicked-pdf-to-sghtmltopdf.md  <- raw Markdown (use this)

Each `.md` file opens with YAML front matter carrying `title`, `author`, `date`, `tags`, `description`, `canonical_url`, `license`, and `estimated_tokens` (for sizing a context window or picking a chunking strategy).

This site is served as static files and cannot honour an `Accept: text/markdown` request header. The `.md` suffix is the equivalent. Content usage preferences are published as a [Content Signal](https://contentsignals.org) in [robots.txt]({{ site.url }}/robots.txt).

Other endpoints:

- [{{ site.url }}/llms-full.txt]({{ site.url }}/llms-full.txt): full text of the {{ site.llm_full_text_posts }} most recent posts, in one file.
- Full text by year, one bounded file each:
{% for year in site.llm_years %}  - [{{ site.url }}/llms/{{ year }}.txt]({{ site.url }}/llms/{{ year }}.txt)
{% endfor %}- [{{ site.url }}/search.json]({{ site.url }}/search.json): every post as JSON with title, url, date, tags, excerpt.
- [{{ site.url }}/feed.xml]({{ site.url }}/feed.xml): Atom feed of recent posts.
- [{{ site.url }}/sitemap.xml]({{ site.url }}/sitemap.xml): every canonical HTML URL.
